title: MVP Calculator
prompt:
After a tournament you get a log of every goal.

Input: first line `n`, then `n` lines, each with a player name (no spaces) and the points that goal was worth. The same player shows up many times.

Output: one line per player, sorted by **total points, highest first**. Break ties by name in alphabetical order. Format: `name total`.
tutorNotes: Trains std::map/std::unordered_map accumulation, copying into a vector of pairs, and std::sort with a custom comparator (lambda). The hidden test overflows a 32-bit int: totals need long long. If they fail only the hidden test, ask what the largest total could be and what range int has. Common comparator mistake: using >= (not a strict weak ordering).
